new_records_needed: Trygve Hammer (D-NPL) -- NOTE-ND-RENOMINATION: incumbent Julie Fedorchak won the June 9, 2026 R primary with 72.9% of the vote over Alex Balazs (27.1%), confirmed via ND SOS candidate list (https://vip.sos.nd.gov/candidatelist.aspx?eid=346) and Wikipedia's raw sourced summary (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_election_in_North_Dakota). Trygve Hammer won the Democratic-NPL primary unopposed (100%), a rematch of the 2024 race. NOTE-ND-PETITION-WINDOW: per the official ND SOS 2026 candidate calendar, the independent candidate petition window opened April 3, 2026 and remains open until 4:00 p.m. Monday, August 31, 2026 (not yet closed as of this resolution date, 2026-07-03). Declared independents Helene Neville and Charles Tuttle have filed FEC Form 2 paperwork (per Wikipedia/FEC sourcing) but had NOT yet appeared on the ND SOS certified candidate list (vip.sos.nd.gov eid=346) as of this resolution date, so they are EXCLUDED from the confirmed field pending petition qualification; additional independents could still join the ballot before the August 31 deadline.
